We are looking for a Senior Product Quality Engineer, EE to join our Product Quality team in San Francisco, California. In this role you will lead Early Field Failure Analysis (EFFA), field quality, and product safety for the Oura Ring, covering both products currently in mass production and earlier generations still in members’ hands.

You will determine why electrical failures occur in the field, confirm the mechanism behind them, and drive the design, process, supplier, and test changes required to prevent them from recurring.
Job responsibilities include leading electrical failure analysis on returned units, building serial-level evidence packages from manufacturing, test, and telemetry data, and establishing commonality across build, supplier, revision, and geography. You will define containment and escalation for field safety issues, direct corrective action with our contract manufacturers (CMs) and suppliers, and verify effectiveness against field and factory data before an action is considered closed.
A core objective of this role is closing the quality loop. You will convert confirmed field and factory findings into design, DFMEA, test coverage, and component selection inputs for NPI programs, so that mechanisms identified on shipping products are designed out of the next generation. This requires close partnership with Electrical Engineering, Firmware, Reliability, Manufacturing, Supplier Quality, Data, and Member Experience.
This role spans the bench, the data, and the factory floor. Strong electrical engineering fundamentals, hands-on failure analysis capability, and practical data analysis skill are all essential for success in this role.
This is a US Hybrid role based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with an in-office requirement of three days per week.

Own electrical Early Field Failure Analysis (EFFA) for Oura Ring products, from returned unit intake and evidence review through technical disposition, confirmed mechanism, and closure
Lead field quality and safety investigations for battery, charging, and power-related issues, including risk assessment, containment and escalation decisions, and the supporting technical rationale for Reliability, Regulatory, and Member Experience
Direct non-destructive-first analysis workflows covering received-condition documentation, electrical characterization, ring diagnostics, optical inspection, and imaging prior to any destructive analysis
Isolate failure mechanisms across power, battery, charging, sensor, clock, connectivity, interconnect, and leakage-related faults to the component, material, or process level using DMM, oscilloscope, current measurement, thermal imaging, micro-probing, and X-ray/CT
Build serial-level evidence packages combining product configuration, hardware and firmware revision, manufacturing genealogy, factory test history, telemetry, and diagnostic records against the member-reported symptom
Analyze field, factory, and FA data to establish commonality across manufacturing site, build lot, supplier, component, ring size, hardware and firmware revision, product age, geography, and diagnostic signature
Distinguish reported symptom from failed function and confirmed mechanism, documenting supporting and contradicting evidence, remaining open questions, and confidence in the disposition
Drive corrective action with CMs and suppliers, including factory containment, process control updates, inspection and test coverage, design and firmware changes, and additional reliability validation
Verify corrective action effectiveness against before-and-after field, factory, reliability, or component data prior to closure
Feed confirmed field and factory findings into NPI through design and DFMEA reviews, component and supplier selection, test coverage definition, traceability requirements, and reliability planning
Partner with Data and Software teams on data ingestion, SQL and Python analysis, dashboards, and triage logic to convert confirmed mechanisms into leading indicators and proactive capture criteria
Establish FA methods, standard operating procedures, equipment requirements, and reporting templates, and build repeatable capability across Oura’s regional labs and CM partners
Present findings to engineering and quality leadership, clearly separating observation, hypothesis, confirmed mechanism, corrective action, and open risk
You are a technical leader who insists on evidence and is comfortable with ambiguity. You understand that a passing functional test is not the same as a robust product, and that the purpose of failure analysis is not to explain a single return but to prevent the same mechanism from reaching future members.

Join an innovative team shaping the future of diagnostics. As a Software Engineer in Test (SET), you will drive quality at the high\-stakes intersection of hardware, software, and biological assays.

In this role, you will architect and implement end\-to\-end automated test strategies for our complex molecular diagnostic platforms, bridging technical requirements with real\-world execution.

You will integrate automated test frameworks that validate physical interfaces, fortify software security, and ensure seamless synchronization between digital logic, mechanical systems, and fluidic/assay protocols.

Leveraging state\-of\-the\-art robotics\-ranging from standard market solutions to bespoke in\-house developments\-you will stress\-test complex platforms in a high\-demand environment.

Operating at the frontier where engineering and chemistry collide, your contributions directly guarantee that clinical laboratories receive fast, precise, and uncompromising diagnostic results.
The Perfect Candidate possesses a degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Medical Technology, or a comparable field.

They bring at least five years of experience as a Software Engineer in Test or Test Automation Engineer, ideally gained within complex mechatronic, medical device, or biotech environments, and demonstrate strong proficiency in software development and clean coding principles.

Expertise in modern test automation frameworks\-with knowledge of behavior\-driven development\-is essential. Additionally, the candidate should have practical experience leveraging AI coding assistants and LLM agents to manage testing assets, while familiarity with Application Lifecycle Management tools like Codebeamer is advantageous.

Strong analytical skills to navigate complex diagnostic systems are required, and an ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level certification is considered a plus.

Quality Assurance for High\-Tech: Development and implementation of automated test strategies for a complex overall system in molecular diagnostics.
BDD Methodology: Active application of Behavior\-Driven Development to translate requirements into executable specifications.
AI\-Driven Test Development: Leverage state\-of\-the\-art AI agents and automated generation tools to design, write, and maintain scalable test cases across software, hardware, and assay workflows.
Development of Test Environments: Construction and maintenance of test frameworks using tools similar to Selenium, Appium, or SpecFlow, supplemented by specific libraries for controlling laboratory robots.
Robotics Integration: Evaluation and integration of commercial robot arms (e.g., Cobots) as well as participation in the development of internal robotics tools to simulate user interactions on the device (e.g., pipetting, loading cartridges).
ALM \& Traceability: Use of ALM tools such as Codebeamer to manage requirements and test cases and to ensure traceability.
CI/CD Integration: Responsibility for automated quality assurance within our GitHub repositories and Azure DevOps (ADO) pipelines.
End\-to\-End Verification: Ensuring data integrity from the barcode scan of the patient sample to the final analysis of the PCR result.
Compliance \& Documentation: Supporting the creation of test plans, protocols, and reports in accordance with ISO 13485 and other relevant regulatory standards for medical devices.

Education: Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Medical Technology, or a comparable qualification.
Technical Expertise: Min. 5 years' experience as a Software Engineer in Test (SET) or Test Automation Engineer, ideally within complex mechatronic, medical device, or biotech systems. You have sound experience in software development and master clean coding principles.
Automation \& BDD Expert: Proficient in using modern test automation frameworks, with desired knowledge of behavior driven development methodologies.
AI Tooling Proficiency: Practical experience using AI coding assistants, LLM agents, or AI\-native test management tools to automate, refactor, and maintain testing assets.
ALM Know\-how: Experience with Application Lifecycle Management tools, ideally Codebeamer, is a major advantage.
Analytical Talent: Ability to familiarize yourself with the logic of complex diagnostic systems.

Testing Experience: ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level certification is a plus.

QuantumLoopAI is one of the UK's fastest-growing healthtech companies. Our AI-powered platform, EMMA, is used by hundreds of organisations across the UK to manage communications, automate workflows and deliver better outcomes through intelligent automation. Backed by leading investors and scaling rapidly ahead of our Series A, we are building the infrastructure that will define the next generation of AI-driven service delivery.

Our platform handles real, live conversations — and because those conversations matter, quality is critical. Small errors have real consequences. We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to own and grow the automated testing that keeps our voice AI platform reliable.
You will build and maintain automated test coverage across backend and frontend, create automation that places and validates real test calls end to end, and measure the accuracy of the speech-to-text (STT) and text-to-speech (TTS) layers that make the platform work. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role where your testing directly protects real users.

Backend and Frontend Test Automation
Build and maintain automated test coverage across backend services and the frontend, ensuring new features ship without breaking existing behaviour.
Integrate tests into CI pipelines so quality checks run automatically on every change.
Work with engineers to turn real-world failures into permanent regression tests.
Voice Pipeline and Call Automation
Build and run outbound-call automation that places test calls through the live voice pipeline, simulates realistic caller scenarios, and validates the platform's behaviour from start to finish.
Test the speech-to-text (STT) layer — measuring transcription accuracy and how reliably the platform understands callers.
Test the text-to-speech (TTS) layer — validating pronunciation, naturalness, and that the voice output behaves correctly.
Run regression testing across multiple conversation flows and catch behavioural drift after changes.
Quality Evaluation and Defect Management
Evaluate calls against conversational quality dimensions — accuracy, tone, flow adherence, understanding, hand-off between stages, summaries, outcome handling, call control, and avoiding unnecessary repetition.
Reproduce, document, and track defects through to resolution, writing clear reproduction steps from real call examples.
Work with engineers, prompt authors, and the operations team to identify quality issues and build permanent test coverage around them.

4+ years of hands-on experience in QA automation or software testing with a strong automation focus.
Strong hands-on Python — you write, debug and maintain test scripts daily, not occasionally.
Experience writing and maintaining automated test suites across both API and UI layers.
Comfortable testing REST APIs and working with structured data (JSON).
Experience with automated web and UI testing frameworks.
Familiarity with version-control workflows (Git) and continuous-integration pipelines — you have integrated automated tests into CI/CD.
Solid grasp of QA methodology — test design, regression strategy, and the defect lifecycle.
Excellent attention to detail and clear written communication.
Comfortable working remotely and aligning to UK business hours (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM GMT/BST).

Exposure to voice or conversational AI testing — metrics such as transcription accuracy (WER), naturalness scoring, or response latency.
Experience with automated or AI-assisted response evaluation.
Telephony or real-time audio and voice testing experience.
Experience working with data to gather and verify test evidence programmatically.
Experience in regulated software environments where quality assurance and compliance processes are important.
Experience working with distributed or remote teams across multiple time zones.

Education: We value skills and experience over formal qualifications.
Working arrangements: Fully remote from India, aligned to UK business hours (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM GMT/BST).
Start date: Flexible.

Competitive package depending on experience
Potential share options
Professional development including conference attendance and CPD support
The opportunity to own test automation for a live voice AI platform at one of the UK's fastest-growing healthtech companies
Remote working with a collaborative, high-ownership engineering culture

At QuantumLoopAI , you will join a team that is building AI-powered products used by hundreds of organisations across the UK. We move fast, take ownership, and celebrate wins together. Our culture values:
Impact over optics. We measure success by real outcomes, not busy work
Transparency. Open communication, honest feedback, shared context
Ownership. You will have real autonomy to shape your work and our platform
Learning. We are building something new, and we learn from every experiment
This is a QA role where your work has direct, visible impact. Every test you build protects real users in real conversations. You will not be writing test scripts in isolation — you will be listening to real calls, diagnosing real failures, and building the automation that prevents them from happening again.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

Starlink believes in providing fast, reliable internet to those that need it most. We design, build, and launch the world's largest and most advanced satellite constellation that is capable of delivering high-speed internet to even the most remote locations.

As we vertically integrate critical hardware, we are building and scaling heterojunction (HJT) solar cell production to power spacecraft and constellation assets with higher efficiency, lower mass, and proven reliability in the space environment.
We are looking for a Solar Cell Quality Engineer who will own the quality of the solar cell fab—and ensure no defective cells escape downstream or to space.

You will own inline and offline cell metrology (offline metrology lab, inline IV test, EL/PL, and related inspection/sort) and define the test methods, sampling frequency, and acceptance logic the factory runs to.

Your work will form the backbone of the Starlink network (photons of sunlight in is directly proportional to photons of data out to customers!) and help provide internet to tens of millions of customers all around the world.

Your work will ensure our solar cells deliver unmatched power density and durability for Starship, Starlink, AI Sat, and deep-space missions.

Your work will form the backbone of the Starlink network (photons of sunlight in is directly proportional to photons of data out to customers!) and help provide internet to tens of millions of customers all around the world.

Own quality of the solar cell fab: prevent escapes to module assembly, satellite integration, and flight; drive containment and disposition when product or process is out of family
Own inline and offline cell metrology as a system, including the offline metrology lab, inline I-V testers, EL/PL, and related inspection equipment (ellipsometry, SEM/EDS, Raman, FTIR, microscopy, 4pt probe, hall effect measurement, optical measurements, etc.).
Define test methods, sampling frequency, acceptance criteria, and reaction plans for in-process and end-of-line cell measurements
Own sorter/binning from a process and quality standpoint: bin definitions, grade gates, retest rules, and hold/release logic
Establish and maintain MSA/GR&R, calibration, correlation, and golden-sample programs so inline and lab data can be trusted
Build SPC, spec limits, and out-of-control action plans on the metrics that catch yield, reliability, and flight risk
Own documentation for quality and metrology tools and methods (SOPs, work instructions, PMs, training) and be the SME for those tools through install, commissioning, and ramp
Partner with process and equipment engineering (texturing, PECVD/a-Si stacks, TCO, metallization) so in-process metrology catches drifts before they become lots of scrap—or lots of escapes
Partner with the solar cell reliability engineer so factory screens (I-V, EL/PL, visual, mechanical) protect the space-qualification envelope rather than duplicating or missing it
Lead root cause analysis on quality escapes and metrology failures (electrical, optical, interfacial, mechanical) using I-V, EL/PL, lifetime, sheet resistance, ellipsometry, and other characterization; close the loop with manufacturing
Define and track quality KPIs (e.g., escape rate, first-pass yield, metrology OEE, GR&R, lot-to-lot variation, containment cycle time) and report status to leadership with clear recommendations
Mentor technicians and junior engineers; set fab quality culture for rigor, speed, and honest interpretation of data

Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline
1+ years of experience in chemical engineering, materials science, electrical engineering, physics, or mechanical engineering in design, analysis, and/or system implementation (internship and extracurricular experience is applicable)

Master’s degree or Ph.D. in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science, electrical engineering, or related technical discipline (especially in PV, thin-film devices, metrology, or quality engineering)
2+ years of hands-on experience in solar cell, PV module, semiconductor device, or high-volume manufacturing quality/metrology (internship/co-op experience may count toward this if highly relevant and hands-on)
Experience defining sampling plans, test methods, and spec limits, and defending them with data (capability, escape risk, cost of quality)
Proficiency with data analysis (e.g., Python, MATLAB, JMP, R, or equivalent) and comfort with statistics (SPC, process capability, GR&R/MSA, DOE basics)
Ability to work full-time on-site in a production and lab environment
Hands-on experience with PV metrology tools (e.g. I-V, Sinton lifetime, EL/PL, 4-point probe, ellipsometry) and end-of-line test/sort
Experience standing up a metrology lab or qualifying new inline test equipment (correlation, calibration, golden wafers/cells)
Experience with SPC, DoE, and lean manufacturing principles
Self-motivated with strong organizational, written, and oral communication skills
Experience with solar cell manufacturing equipment, such as wet chemical processing equipment, PE-CVD equipment, PVD machines, metallization and final test equipment, and wafer inspection equipment. Experience in evaporation tools and ALD tools are a plus

Ability to travel frequently for work, potentially for extended periods of time during machine buyoffs and startup
Ability to lift 25 lbs. unassisted
Lifting, standing, climbing, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, stretching, and carrying are generally required to perform the functions of this position
Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed

角色与职责
核心工作任务 依据功能与工艺需求完成元器件选型及方案设计
系统集成：搭建各元器件（机械臂、相机、夹爪、传感器、MAE 等）之间的通信与协同逻辑，基于 ROS/ROS 2 生态完成系统级集成与二次开发，让所有组件协同运作成为可调度的系统解决方案
产线部署与调试
安全与合规验证：联合安全工程师 / 环境健康安全（EHS）部门组织安全验收，确保方案在投入生产前符合博世集团安全标准及中国相关法规要求

s.h: 数字化与数据接口集成：与 IT/MES 团队协作定义数据字典与接口协议，为后续的预测性维护提供数据基础

岗位职责 对机器人解决方案的质量、准时交付及成本负责
支撑自动化方案的流程搭建与标准化建设
配合开展内部培训相关工作

能够系统性地汇报项目整体进展状态

在项目团队中做好协作成员，配合整体工作推进

机电工程、自动化、机器人工程、电气工程或相关专业本科及以上学历

Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.
By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.
With Stord , brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord ’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.
Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.
Stord is building the operating system for modern supply chain — a unified platform handling Order Management, Warehouse Management, Transportation, and Consumer Experience for brands doing over $10B in commerce annually.
As Stord 's platform has scaled, testing has stayed distributed and inconsistent — each team building its own coverage, its own patterns, its own tooling, with no shared standard for what "tested" means before a feature reaches UAT. This role exists to fix that, and to build the team that fixes it at scale.

As the first SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test) leadership hire at Stord , you'll set the framework standards, the AI-assisted test generation strategy, and the CI-gated automation approach that every SDET you hire will build on, starting with a blank slate, before anyone else's habits calcify.

Quality outcomes stay owned by engineering teams; you're building and leading the enablement function that lets them hit those outcomes at scale.
This role is for someone who has designed test architecture before and knows how to turn that judgment into a team, not just an individual practice.

You can look at a fragmented testing landscape and see the two or three decisions that matter before the rest cascades, and you'd rather build the standard once and hire the team that scales it than keep executing inside someone else's framework.

If you want the first shot at defining what test automation looks like at Stord , and the mandate to hire and grow the people who build it, this role was built for you. Why This Role
You're the first SDET leadership hire at Stord , the framework standards, tooling choices, and AI test infrastructure strategy are yours to set, not inherited.
You hire the team: every SDET you bring on builds on the standards, tooling, and technical direction you establish from day one, not the other way around.
AI-assisted test generation isn't a future roadmap item bolted onto this role, it's a core part of the mandate from day one, for you and for every engineer you hire.
Your scope is cross-org by design: the framework and standards you set are what every embedded SDET, across every product group they land in, builds on.
This role exists because of a leadership-level engineering quality investment, you'll have direct visibility with R&D leadership on strategy and roadmap, not just execution.
You're building a high-bar, high-craft team on purpose, not a large one, every hiring decision is yours, and the standard is not lowered to fill a seat faster.

Team Building & Technical Standards
Hire the SDET team, defining and holding the technical bar rather than delegating it
Set framework standards, tooling decisions, and technical direction before the team's habits calcify
Establish what "tested" means at Stord before a feature reaches UAT, and hold the team accountable to it
AI-First Test Automation Strategy
Own the AI-assisted test generation mandate: converting acceptance criteria and user stories directly into test scripts is the default way tests get built, not a supplementary tool
Set the patterns and guardrails for where AI-generated tests are trustworthy versus where they need human review
Model and enforce AI-fluent ways of working across the team you build
E2E Framework Across Three Testing Surfaces
Build and own the automation strategy across interactive web application (UI), API, and Kafka eventing (event-driven/async) surfaces
Prioritize API-level integration testing first, chosen for speed to build and resilience, with UI and Kafka eventing coverage layered on as the framework matures
Set resilience as a non-negotiable design requirement: retry/backoff patterns, deterministic test data, and explicit handling of eventual consistency for async flows, a flaky suite erodes trust faster than no automation at all
Coverage & Regression Infrastructure
Build regression test registers and own contract/API test tooling across services
Wire coverage dashboards so coverage gaps are visible, not assumed
Define load and performance test frameworks that engineering teams can apply to their own stories
Test Environment Partnership
Partner with SRE on the dedicated Test environment, schema and config parity with production is an ongoing shared concern
Co-design the longer-term move to ephemeral per-PR environments for isolated load testing and PR-level E2E validation once the Test environment and framework are stable

Required
E2E test framework design — You've built and owned a Playwright (or equivalent) framework from scratch, not just written tests inside one someone else designed.
CI/CD test gating — You know how to wire automated tests into CI (GitHub Actions or equivalent) so they actually block bad releases instead of running as an afterthought.

Job Description
Job Title : Software Design Assurance Quality Engineer

· Facilitates the development, maintenance, and management of comprehensive software quality documentation, including Software Requirement Specifications (SRS), ensuring they are accurate, up-to-date, and fully compliant with relevant standards and regulatory requirements throughout the software lifecycle, working under limited supervision.

· Leads the assessment of software designs, including reviewing test and performance data, to ensure they meet quality, safety, and regulatory standards, while identifying and addressing quality engineering deficiencies to embed quality within the design.

· Conducts in-depth root cause analysis for software quality issues, employing problem-solving techniques to resolve deficiencies and improve software design processes, ensuring that quality is integral to the development process.

· Validates key software design inputs such as usability, reliability, performance, localizability, safety, privacy, and cost to ensure they meet customer and regulatory requirements, supporting the delivery of high-quality software products.

· Provides effective oversight of the execution of software quality plans and associated risk management activities throughout the software lifecycle, ensuring that all design-related activities are managed according to defined processes.

· Utilizes post-market analytics and statistics to monitor software performance in the field, providing feedback to manufacturing, suppliers, and design teams, while initiating corrective actions or field actions when required to maintain software quality.

· Ensures the development of comprehensive Software Quality Plans that cover all stages of the software lifecycle, from design through to post-market, supporting the design of these plans and ensuring adherence to quality and regulatory standards.

· Possesses and applies working knowledge of relevant global regulations, requirements, and standards, ensuring that all quality activities and software design processes comply with applicable regulatory requirements, facilitating compliance throughout the software development lifecycle.

· Acts as a subject matter expert, providing guidance to meet schedules, resolve technical problems, and manage performance requirements, including mentoring on quality engineering practices, regulatory compliance, and QMS processes.

· Monitors, and reports on key software quality metrics, ensuring these metrics are aligned with business objectives and regulatory expectations, while communicating quality-related performance indicators to relevant stakeholders.

· Helps to identify opportunities for process improvements within software quality engineering, advocating for and implementing best practices, tools, and innovative methodologies to enhance software quality and regulatory compliance.

Ob Industrieproduktion, Energie- oder maritime Wirtschaft: Wir denken ganzheitlich und packen schon heute die Herausforderungen von morgen an - für eine nachhaltige Wertschöpfung unserer Kunden. ## **Folgende Aufgaben können wir Ihnen anbieten** ##
Als Quality Manager unterstützen Sie das Projektmanagement durch die Sicherstellung und Weiterentwicklung qualitätsrelevanter Prozesse in internationalen Projekten. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem internen Supplier-Quality-Team von Everllence fungieren Sie als Schnittstelle zum Headquarter und stellen sicher, dass Lieferanten die Qualitätsanforderungen, Standards und Richtlinien von Everllence erfüllen.

s.h: ABOUT US METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability
s.t:
We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production.
And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era.
Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions.
READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT? If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer.
The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.
We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.
Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.
YOUR MISSION PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI
Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable
Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it
Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown
Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions
Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant
Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance
OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary
YOUR PROFILE 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation
Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding
Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations
Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient
Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery
Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus
Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus
Independent, structured, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership. You challenge assumptions, hold suppliers to a high standard, and document what you build
Fluent in English; German and/or Dutch is a plus. Ideally based in or near Cologne or the Benelux/border region, with valid EU work authorisation and the willingness to travel to our Smart Sorting Facility in Belgium, Maasmechelen
WHY JOIN US? You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with a significant impact
You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage

About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️
Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!
We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.
With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️
Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.
Why RoomPriceGenie?
We take both culture and product seriously: recognized as Best Place to Work in HotelTech (2026) and Best Revenue Management Software (2026) . We power pricing for thousands of hotels worldwide on a modern data stack.
This is a fully remote role within Europe (UTC+0 to UTC+2) . You will have genuine ownership, strong support, and the opportunity to build high-value internal AI systems and agents that make our operational teams significantly faster and smarter.

As an AI Systems & Automation Engineer , you will drive internal AI adoption across Customer Success, Sales, and Operations. Your job isn't to build raw ML models or write throwaway demos. You will work directly with business leads to unblock legacy processes, connect internal data to core operational tools, and deploy dependable, supervised AI agents that automate complex workflows.
You will join our AI & Security team and bridge the gap between our core data platforms (Snowflake, Postgres, DocumentDB, S3) and our GTM stack (HubSpot, Chargebee, Modjo, Notion), establishing practical patterns for safe, agentic automation across the business.

Translate Business Pain into Systems: Partner directly with Customer Success, Sales, and Ops teams to map out manual, multi-step workflows and design high-ROI AI automation targets.
Build Production Agents & Integrations: Write clean, maintainable code (Python/TypeScript) connecting LLM APIs to internal data stores and third-party SaaS platforms (HubSpot, Chargebee, Modjo, Notion).
Implement Modern Agent Standards: Build modular agent capabilities using standardized tools and schemas (such as Agent Skills standards, Claude Plugins, or custom function-calling pipelines) to give models safe, structured action boundaries.
Design Human-in-the-Loop Workflows: Implement strict guardrails, schema validation, human approval gates, and escalation paths so non-technical staff can safely supervise AI outputs.
Ensure Integration Reliability: Manage API rate limits, Webhooks, asynchronous jobs, and retry logic to keep integrations rock-solid as internal data volume grows.
Measure & Iterate: Build lightweight evaluation harnesses to track agent accuracy, hallucination rates, latency, and cost, optimizing prompt architectures and model choices based on real production usage.
Your Profile
Strong Software Fundamentals: Solid background in Python and/or TypeScript, asynchronous execution, REST APIs, Webhooks, SQL, and working with relational or analytical databases.
Claude & LLM Ecosystem Expertise: Deep, hands-on proficiency with Claude (Anthropic API, Prompt Engineering, Workbench, SDKs) and adjacent modern developer applications.
Agent Skill & Tool Design: Familiarity with modern agent capability frameworks, such as standard Agent Skills ( agentskills.io ), Claude Plugins / Model Context Protocol (MCP), or structured tool execution design.
Integration & Ecosystem Familiarity: Experience consuming complex SaaS APIs (HubSpot, Chargebee, Modjo). Proficiency with Notion (APIs, workspace structures, and knowledge management) is a strong plus.
Operational Empathy: Business-minded engineer who enjoys talking to non-technical colleagues, understanding messy legacy processes, and building practical tools that make their daily jobs easier.
Location & Communication: Fluent in English and based in European time zones (UTC+0 to UTC+2).

Frontier is an independent video game developer and publisher, crafting immersive gaming experiences with fun gameplay and unparalleled artistic quality. Renowned for its iconic creative management simulation games, Frontier captivates players worldwide with immersive and authentic game worlds. The modern studio is located in the vibrant technology hub of Cambridge (UK). The talented team at Frontier are dedicated to nurturing our existing portfolio and delivering our exciting future roadmap.
This role is offered on a full in-studio basis or a hybrid basis (minimum 3 days per week in the studio). We can provide a comprehensive relocation support package as part of any offer, should you need to relocate.

We’re looking for a Senior QA Tester who will be responsible for testing Frontier’s games throughout all phases of development, from pre-production through post-release content.
In this role, you’ll work on medium-to-high-risk features, designing and executing comprehensive test suites, and conducting both regression testing and playtesting. Leveraging QA experience, you’ll proactively identify and resolve issues, provide guidance to QA team members and recommend and implement improvements.
Depending on project needs, you may also assume Assistant Lead or Team Lead responsibilities for specific phases or entire projects.

Write, run and maintain medium-to-high risk test specifications and suites for new and existing projects, ensuring efficient time reporting and estimates on given tasks and written suites.
Conduct playtesting using a variety of test personas e.g. destructive testing and player-like testing.
Envision user stories and gather data with provided instructions.
Identify and report issues in a clear and accurate manner.
Perform regression testing for both internal and external issues.
Act as point of contact for specific features, regularly collaborating with cross-discipline teams to gather and relay relevant information back to QA.
Provide guidance and technical mentoring to other testers, including guidance on their documentation and advanced troubleshooting of other testers on the project.
Raise potential future hurdles for testing, pre-empt problems, and suggest best fixes and ideas for further testing.
Contribute to product information, identification of problem areas and analysis of trends to anticipate and navigate risks.

Significant QA experience in the games industry and a strong understanding of QA tools, procedures, methodologies and workflows.
Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Experience aligning testing with requirements, managing priorities and successfully collaborating across disciplines/teams.
Proven leadership or mentoring experience.

Ability to drive innovation and continuous improvement.
Proven ability managing people.

You will work with talented and passionate people to support, develop or publish our sophisticated and enduring games, in a creative, collaborative and inclusive environment. We love what we do, and we work hard to provide outstanding experiences for our players.
Wellbeing is a big focus at Frontier, and we are continually evolving how we can support our people. We encourage a healthy work/life balance and provide a range of wellbeing activities, initiatives and sessions to support both mental and physical health.
We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes a success-based annual bonus, share option schemes, life assurance, private family healthcare, flexitime working hours, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, in-house subsidised catering, support with relocation, a Cycle to Work scheme, free bike servicing, and social activities and events.

Deine Aufgaben Du baust und betreibst unsere n8n-Automationen und verbindest CRM, Customer-Support-Tools, E-Mail und Kalender zu nahtlosen Workflows – von der KI-gestützten Ticket-Klassifizierung über intelligentes Eskalations-Routing bis hin zu automatischen Benachrichtigungen bei kritischen Ereignissen.
Du entwickelst Automationslogik und Workflow-Regeln in unserem Support-Tool und sorgst dafür, dass unser Eskalationsmodell technisch sauber abgebildet und Informationen zuverlässig zwischen den Systemen synchronisiert werden.
Du integrierst KI-Bausteine dort in unsere Automationen, wo sie echten Zeitgewinn und Mehrwert schaffen. Gleichzeitig denkst du Datenschutz und Datenminimierung von Anfang an mit: Welche Daten an ein Modell übermittelt werden dürfen und welche nicht, ist für dich Teil eines guten Designs.
Du baust mit Sicherheits- und Qualitätsbewusstsein statt nach dem Prinzip „ship and pray“: Neue Flows werden zunächst inaktiv getestet , mit realistischen Testfällen geprüft und mit Deduplication-Logik, Fallbacks und Fehlerbehandlung ausgestattet, bevor sie produktiv gehen.
Du arbeitest eng mit Operations und Customer Success zusammen, übersetzt operative Pain Points in konkrete, robuste Automationen und kommunizierst proaktiv und transparent , wo ein Flow steht und warum etwas gegebenenfalls länger dauert.
Du nutzt KI-Tools wie Claude oder Cursor selbstverständlich als Hebel, um schneller zu bauen, neue Lösungen auszuprobieren und Dinge umzusetzen , die du ohne diese Werkzeuge vielleicht gar nicht entwickelt hättest.
Dein Profil Du hast bereits Erfahrung mit Workflow-Automation – idealerweise mit n8n, Zapier oder Make – oder kommst aus der Backend-Entwicklung und bringst einen starken Fokus auf APIs und System-Integrationen mit. (Required)
Du bist sicher im Umgang mit REST-APIs und Webhooks , liest und debuggst JSON-Payloads ohne Umwege und findest schnell die Ursache, wenn ein Integrationsflow nicht das tut, was er soll.
Erfahrung mit dem Zoho-Ökosystem (CRM, Desk) ist ein großes Plus. Deluge-Scripting ist kein Muss – wichtiger ist deine Bereitschaft, dich schnell und selbstständig einzuarbeiten .
Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wie man KI-Bausteine wie Klassifizierung oder Textgenerierung robust in produktive Workflows integriert – und weißt gleichzeitig, wo die Grenzen von Automatisierung liegen und welche Entscheidungen besser beim Menschen bleiben.
Du bringst solide Kenntnisse in JavaScript/TypeScript oder Python mit, um bei Bedarf Custom-Code-Nodes zu entwickeln.
Du arbeitest strukturiert und sicherheitsbewusst : Du denkst an Testfälle vor der Aktivierung, Fallbacks im Fehlerfall und eine gute Nachvollziehbarkeit , damit auch andere deine Flows später problemlos verstehen und warten können.
Du kommunizierst proaktiv und klar – auch dann, wenn etwas länger dauert oder nicht wie geplant läuft. Operations und Customer Success können sich auf dich als verlässlichen Partner verlassen.
Du nutzt KI-Tools wie Claude und Cursor gerne als Produktivitäts-Booster, um schneller zu arbeiten, neue Lösungen auszuprobieren und bessere Ergebnisse zu erzielen .
Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1) .

s.h: MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES IN THE BUSINESS

As a Lead Test Engineer (Consultant) in Kainos , you’ll be a technical leader and innovator in software testing, providing strong test leadership and direction within a multi-skilled agile team, within the public, defence or healthcare sector.

Taking responsibility for the strategy, design and development of automated, manual, and non-functional tests, you’ll help the team to deliver working application software that meets user needs and is of sufficient quality for promotion to users. It’s a fast-paced environment so it is important for you to make sound, reasoned decisions.

You’ll do this whilst learning about new technologies and approaches, with talented colleagues who will help you learn, develop and grow.
You’ll manage, coach and develop a small number of staff, with a focus on managing employee performance and assisting in their career development. You’ll also provide direction and leadership for your team as you solve challenging problems together.
As a technical leader in the team, you will also interact with customers, share knowledge and mentor those around you.

Experience of ensuring testing layers have adequate coverage in line with software testing principles and practices.
Expertise in designing, creating and maintaining tests scripts and test approaches, including manual and automated testing across all layers of an application including non-functional test coverage.
Experience using Test Automation open-source technologies (e.g. one of the following Selenium, JUnit,TestNG, Cucumber, Cypress), and configuring tools for testing such as Jenkins and/or TeamCity, within a continuous integration environment.
Practical knowledge of at least one object-oriented programming language (e.g. Java).
A high level of technical awareness and a sound understanding of software architectures.
We are passionate about developing people – experience in managing others, setting objectives, giving feedback and leading performance reviews.
Passionate technologist, keen to expand knowledge of latest QA tools, tech and methodologies.

Highlight Health is a mission-driven company that protects consumer rights and controls healthcare costs exclusively for self-funded employers and their stop loss carriers. We are a profitable, fast-growing company.
We are currently upgrading our core operations into a sophisticated, proprietary Claims Intelligence Platform. This isn't a prototype; it is an innovative system of record handling protected health information (PHI) and generating financial recommendations with real-world legal and economic weight.
Highlight Health engineers new ways to protect consumer rights and control healthcare costs for self-funded employers. Nearly every American has felt the pain of the skyrocketing cost of healthcare. Highlight Health brings them solutions.

We use our subject-matter expertise to reduce costs for employers and relieve ordinary Americans of burdensome medical costs. Highlight Health is proud of its inclusive workplace that brings together highly skilled leadership and employees from all walks of life.
We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to define and own our test practice from the ground up. Our engineering team builds in parallel using AI-assisted development as the default way of working, which means code ships fast; your job is to decide what “tested” means on this platform and build the coverage that proves it.
At Highlight Health , the output of your work matters. You'll be defining test strategy for a platform where the “correctness bar” is exceptionally high, because the results directly affect what employers pay for healthcare and what our AI extraction pipeline reads from real claims documents. If you've built a QA practice from nothing before and want to do it again somewhere the stakes are real, we would love to hear from you.

Define and own the overall test strategy: the right mix of unit, integration, and end-to-end coverage, and where extraction-regression and data-isolation testing fit relative to UI testing.
Define and own regression testing for our AI-assisted document extraction pipeline, validating structured output against a maintained set of known documents and expected results.
Define and own row-level security and multi-tenant data isolation testing at the database layer, verifying isolation holds even when queries bypass the application layer.
Define and own end-to-end browser test coverage for core workflows (case intake, review, packet generation, admin) using frameworks such as Playwright and Puppeteer scoped to packet/PDF output validation.
Set testing standards for the engineering team to follow in their own feature work, and review test coverage on pull requests the way a senior engineer reviews code.
Own synthetic test data generation, ensuring realistic edge-case coverage without ever using real, non-de-identified PHI.
Bring test coverage and “definition of tested” decisions to compliance stakeholders for sign-off, rather than co-defining case by case.
Serve as the team's primary point of judgment on testing and quality questions, escalating to the CTO only for decisions with broader business or release-timing impact.
The Technical Stack
End-to-end testing: Playwright (primary framework for browser-based workflow testing, cross-browser coverage, and AI-agent-driven test authoring via MCP).
Document/PDF validation: Puppeteer (targeted use for packet generation output verification).
Frontend unit/integration testing: Vitest, React Testing Library.
Backend testing: pytest, with dedicated suites for extraction regression (golden-set) and row-level security.
Database: Azure Database for PostgreSQL, row-level security enforced at both application and database layers.
CI/CD: Azure DevOps pipelines.
Compliance targets: HIPAA, SOC 2 Type 2.

7-10 years in QA automation, including direct experience building a test practice from scratch at a company that didn't already have one, not just operating inside an established QA org.
Demonstrated ownership of test strategy and tooling decisions, not just execution of someone else's plan.
Hands-on production experience with Playwright or a comparable modern E2E framework; familiarity with Puppeteer a plus for document/PDF validation work.
Strong SQL skills and comfortable with writing and reasoning about raw queries directly against PostgreSQL.
Experience with modern frontend test frameworks (Vitest, Jest, or similar) and backend test frameworks (pytest or similar).
Comfort designing tests for deterministic data-transformation problems, including AI/ML pipeline output validation and financial or structured data reconciliation.
Hands-on experience using AI tools to generate, expand, or accelerate test coverage.
Working knowledge of healthcare data compliance, or ability to ramp quickly with an internal compliance team.
Comfortable being the senior voice on quality with no QA team above you. This role sets the standard, it doesn't inherit one.
Healthcare or fintech background is a genuine advantage. This platform produces recommendations that affect what employers pay for healthcare.

Competitive salary based on experience. Highlight Health offers an attractive benefits package, including healthcare cost reimbursement, paid time off, commuting benefits, short-term disability, an employer 401(k) contribution, and bonuses.
If you are based in the Philadelphia area, you will have the option of working in-office on a flexible schedule.

**Rejoignez un acteur clé de la micro-fabrication médicale**
Chez Resonetics, nous repoussons les limites de la micro-fabrication au service des dispositifs médicaux et du diagnostic. Nos technologies de pointe permettent à nos clients d-innover et d-améliorer la vie des patients à travers le monde.
Notre site de Puidoux, qui compte 150 collaborateurs, est un fournisseur stratégique de tubes métalliques et composants de haute précision destinés aux appareils médicaux. Dans un contexte de croissance et d-exigence réglementaire forte, nous renforçons notre équipe qualité.
Nous recherchons un **Quality Engineer expérimenté** , prêt à jouer un rôle central dans la performance qualité de notre site.
**Votre mission**
En tant que Quality Engineer, vous jouez un rôle clé dans le maintien et l-amélioration de notre Système de Management de la Qualité et accompagnez les équipes opérationnelles dans la maîtrise de nos produits et procédés.
Véritable partenaire de la Production, du contrôle qualité, de l-Engineering/NPI ainsi que de nos clients et fournisseurs, vous intervenez au plus près des opérations pour prévenir les risques, résoudre les problématiques qualité et contribuer à l-amélioration continue de nos performances.
Vous évoluez dans un environnement technique, international et fortement réglementé, où votre expertise contribue directement à la fiabilité de composants destinés à des dispositifs médicaux innovants.
**Vos responsabilités**
**? Système de Management de la Qualité**
* Contribuer au maintien et à l-amélioration continue du Système de Management de la Qualité (SMQ) conformément aux exigences applicables, notamment ISO 13485
* Rédiger, réviser et maintenir les procédures, instructions et enregistrements qualité
* Participer à la formation initiale et continue des collaborateurs aux exigences du SMQ
* Planifier et conduire des audits internes et assurer le suivi des plans d-actions associés
* Participer à la préparation et au suivi des audits clients et audits de certification
* Contribuer à la veille normative et réglementaire applicable au site
**? Qualité opérationnelle & résolution de problèmes**
* Assurer le traitement et le suivi des non-conformités (NCMR), de leur investigation jusqu-à leur clôture
* Piloter les investigations qualité et les analyses de causes en utilisant des méthodologies structurées telles que 5 Why, Ishikawa, 8D ou DMAIC
* Définir, mettre en œuvre et suivre les actions correctives et préventives (CAPA) et vérifier leur efficacité
* Participer au traitement des réclamations clients, conduire les investigations associées et contribuer à la préparation des réponses clients
* Être le référent Qualité lors des réunions quotidiennes Tier 2, en collaboration avec les équipes Production, NPI et Engineering, afin d-identifier, prioriser et résoudre les problématiques opérationnelles et qualité
* Apporter un support qualité quotidien aux équipes de Production, QC et Engineering/NPI
* Participer à la définition, au développement et à l-amélioration des plans de contrôle
* Contribuer aux analyses de risques produits et procédés (FMEA / AMDEC)
* Utiliser les outils statistiques appropriés pour analyser et améliorer la performance des procédés : SPC, MSA, Gage R&R, études de capabilité Cp/Cpk, analyses de tendances, etc.
* Participer aux initiatives Lean, de réduction des non-conformités et d-amélioration continue
**? Validation & maîtrise des procédés**
* Participer aux validations et revalidations des équipements, procédés et méthodes de contrôle (IQ/OQ/PQ)
* Contribuer à la définition des critères d-acceptation et à l-analyse des résultats de validation
* Participer aux activités de FAI / PPAP et autres dossiers qualité spécifiques aux exigences clients
* Évaluer l-impact qualité des modifications de produits, procédés, équipements ou méthodes dans le cadre du Change Control
* Contribuer à garantir la maîtrise et la robustesse des procédés de fabrication
**? Interface clients & fournisseurs**
* Être un interlocuteur qualité privilégié des clients pour les sujets relevant de votre périmètre
* Participer aux échanges techniques et qualité avec les clients ainsi qu-aux revues des exigences applicables
* Contribuer à l-évaluation des demandes de modification et des exigences qualité spécifiques clients
* Participer aux évaluations et au suivi de la performance qualité des fournisseurs
* Conduire ou participer aux audits fournisseurs
* Collaborer avec les différentes entités du groupe Resonetics sur des problématiques et projets qualité transverses
**Votre profil**
* Bachelor en ingénierie, qualité, sciences des matériaux, mécanique, microtechnique ou formation technique équivalente
* Minimum 5 ans d-expérience en ingénierie qualité, idéalement dans le domaine des dispositifs médicaux ou dans un environnement industriel fortement réglementé
* Bonne maîtrise des exigences de la norme ISO 13485
* Expérience pratique de la gestion des non-conformités, CAPA, réclamations clients et analyses de causes
* Bonne connaissance des outils de résolution de problèmes et d-analyse de risques : 8D, 5 Why, Ishikawa, FMEA/AMDEC
* Solides compétences en SPC, MSA, Gage R&R et études de capabilité

* Esprit analytique, rigueur et capacité à structurer et prioriser les activités
* Autonomie, pragmatisme et forte orientation résolution de problèmes
* Excellentes capacités de communication et aptitude à travailler avec des équipes multidisciplinaires et internationales
**Ce que nous vous offrons**
* Un rôle clé et transverse avec un impact direct sur la qualité de composants destinés à des dispositifs médicaux
* Un environnement industriel de haute précision, technologiquement exigeant et stimulant

* L-opportunité de contribuer concrètement à l-amélioration et à la transformation de nos processus qualité
* Des possibilités de développement professionnel au sein d-un groupe international en croissance

If you want to build and own the automated testing platform that powers a core piece of developer infrastructure, this is for you. You will focus on writing high-impact code, removing engineering friction, and setting the technical direction for quality on TeamCity.
About JetBrains
We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

As our user base grows and enterprise pipelines become more complex, ensuring the highest quality for TeamCity is critical for the people who depend on us daily.
We are looking for a senior engineer to own the quality engineering platform behind TeamCity. This is not a manual testing role or a suite maintenance job. You will spend your time writing code, building the tooling and frameworks that enable dozens of product engineers to ship confidently, removing manual work surrounding releases, and making our developer experience measurably better.
You will lead the technical direction for quality on a large, feature-rich product, bring practical AI approaches into the workflow where they genuinely add value, and collaborate across teams to help product engineers own their tests.

Evolve the automated testing platform, including frameworks, infrastructure, reporting, and CI/CD chains.
Identify slow, manual, or fragile parts of our engineering process – such as release automation, feedback loops, and test flakiness – and fix them at the root.
Integrate AI into the quality workflow for test generation with guardrails, automated failure triage, and self-healing tests.
Work directly with product teams to help them write and own their tests, review their contributions, and evangelize solid test design.
Investigate failures and flakiness across both tests and product code to drive them to resolution.
Participate in all stages of product development, from initial design through release, interacting with internal and external users.

An engineer’s approach to quality, preferring to build tools and automate processes rather than maintain legacy tasks.
Strong architectural judgment and a commitment to writing clean, maintainable code.
Practical curiosity about AI, with a clear point of view on where it genuinely helps and where it falls short.
A habit of working independently without formal specifications, figuring out the product, and determining what matters most.
Clear, direct communication skills and the initiative to walk up to developers and persuade teams to improve how they work.
An interest in mentoring colleagues, setting technical standards, and sharing knowledge across teams.
What you’ll need
Advanced skills in Kotlin or Java, with a solid grasp of object-oriented design and design patterns.
Hands-on experience building and maintaining test automation for complex, mission-critical backends, web services, or desktop applications.
Proficiency with testing frameworks (TestNG or JUnit) and browser automation (Selenium WebDriver, Selenide, or Playwright).
Experience with build automation tools such as Gradle or Maven, containerization using Docker or Podman, and reporting tools like Allure.
Command of Git and a solid understanding of software testing principles and concurrent programming concepts.
A proven track record of creating internal platform tools or developer-experience improvements that measurably speed up engineering workflows.
Fluency in spoken and written English.
What success looks like
Success in this role means transforming our quality infrastructure into a seamless, fast, and reliable platform that engineering teams love to use. You will have eliminated major sources of manual release work, reduced test flakiness, and established automated feedback loops that let developers ship code with total confidence.

Product engineers will independently write high-quality tests using your frameworks, and your pragmatic integration of AI tools will have measurably improved failure triage and test creation.

REMATIQ turn hundreds of page of complex regulations (like MDR and FDA guidance) into structured, actionable requirements that plug directly into our customers’ development and quality processes. As a Manual QA Engineer at REMATIQ, you will own product quality across the edge cases automated tests don’t catch and the bugs that need to be driven through to resolution.
You’ll work closely with Engineering to explore unusual documents, broken inputs, interrupted workflows, non-deterministic AI outputs, permission edge cases, and other failure modes that are difficult to anticipate upfront.
This is a hands-on quality ownership role. You’ll combine exploratory testing with disciplined bug triage, making sure issues are reproducible, prioritised appropriately, fixed, verified, and genuinely closed.

Explore edge cases beyond automated testing. Automated tests check what someone thought to check. You’ll explore unusual documents, broken inputs, half-finished workflows, non-deterministic AI outputs, permission corner cases, and other scenarios that may otherwise be missed.
Own the bug backlog from report to resolution. Reproduce and document incoming issues, assess severity, prioritise with the Engineering Lead, track fixes, verify them, and keep the backlog accurate and actionable.

Strong manual QA experience on web products, including exploratory testing, test design, and regression planning
Experience owning bug triage and backlog quality, not just reporting issues and moving on
Exceptionally clear bug reports with reproducible steps, environment details, and expected vs. actual behaviour
Enough technical fluency to investigate before escalating: browser dev tools, logs, network requests, APIs, and basic system behaviour
Good judgement about risk and the confidence to say “this isn’t ready” when it matters
Fluent English, our working language
Nice to have: experience in regulated domains such as medical devices, pharma, or finance; ISTQB certification; German.
Why this role is interesting
Quality is central to the product. Thoroughness is part of the work, not an afterthought.
You’ll work with AI-enabled software. That includes testing non-deterministic AI outputs alongside more traditional product behaviour.
You’ll work closely with an AI-first engineering team and MedTech domain experts.

Are you the kind of engineer who sees quality as a technical challenge rather than a manual process? Do you enjoy building automated test frameworks, creating release safeguards and preventing production issues before they happen? Are you as comfortable writing code as you are designing quality strategies and identifying risks across complex systems? If you enjoy improving how software is built, tested and released, DFYNE could be exactly where you belong.

A picture paints a thousand words… and we’re sure you don’t want to sit here reading a corporate essay about who we are. Honestly, how can you really get under the skin of DFYNE from a few lines on a screen? So instead, go have a look for yourself, see what we’re about, what we stand for, and why people love us: www.dfyne.com .

s.h: About the role — DFYNE Your Career
s.t:
Before I tell you more about the role, let me introduce myself. I’m Bruce, Head of Development at DFYNE, and I’m looking for our first dedicated Senior QA Automation Engineer. This is a hands-on engineering role that will help define quality engineering across DFYNE.

Reporting directly to the Head of Development, you will work alongside our Staff Software Engineer to build the test infrastructure, automation coverage and quality gates that allow our teams to move quickly without compromising reliability.

You will help protect systems that handle commission payouts, refunds, inventory synchronisation, shipping labels and other business-critical processes where quality has a direct commercial impact.

· Ownership mentality

· Engineering-first approach

· Attention to detail

· Risk-based thinking

· Continuous improvement

· Build and maintain integration test infrastructure that runs against real databases and realistic service environments.

· Design and implement automated regression coverage across business-critical workflows.

· Own CI quality gates and contribute to release readiness processes.

· Develop end-to-end testing coverage for revenue-critical customer journeys.

· Create and maintain realistic and secure test data strategies.

· Work closely with engineers to identify and prevent quality risks early in the development lifecycle.

· Improve test reliability, execution speed and developer adoption.

· Support incident investigations by identifying testing gaps and opportunities for preventative coverage.

· Contribute to engineering standards, software quality practices and continuous improvement initiatives.

· Collaborate with Product, Engineering and Operations teams to ensure quality requirements are understood and delivered.

· 5+ years of experience in QA Automation, SDET or software engineering with a quality focus.

· Strong TypeScript or Python development experience.

· Deep integration testing experience using real dependencies including databases, queues and simulated third-party services.

· Strong Playwright, Cypress or equivalent end-to-end testing experience.

· Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD quality gates, ideally using GitHub Actions.

· Strong understanding of automated testing strategies and risk-based testing approaches.

· Experience building scalable, maintainable test frameworks.

· Ability to write production-quality code.

· Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

· Strong problem-solving and analytical capability.

· E-commerce or payments experience.

· Contract testing experience.

· Performance and load testing experience.

· Google Cloud Platform familiarity.

· Terraform and Infrastructure as Code experience.

s.h: So, what’s in it for you?
s.t:
